RDM-7 Desktop — Tauri overlay (ADR-0007) #! ============================================================================ #! This file holds EVERY desktop-specific difference from the firmware web #! editor. tools/merge_overlay.py applies these blocks onto #! src/firmware-base.html (a verbatim copy of RDM-7_Dash/main/web/index.html) #! to produce src/dist/index.html — the HTML the Tauri webview loads. #! #! To update the editor from firmware: python tools/sync_firmware.py #! If the merge fails, an anchor drifted: fix the anchor here, re-run #! tools/merge_overlay.py. Never edit src/dist/ or src/firmware-base.html. #! #! bottom: 80px; left: 50%; transform: translateX(-50%); z-index: 3500; background: hsl(220, 15%, 16%); border: 1px solid hsla(0, 0%, 100%, 0.12); border-radius: var(--radius-md); padding: 12px 20px; min-width: 300px; box-shadow: var(--shadow-md); display: none; } .dl-progress-overlay.visible { display: block; } .dl-progress-label { font-size: 12px; color: hsl(0, 0%, 75%); margin-bottom: 8px; white-space: nowrap; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; } .dl-progress-track { height: 6px; background: hsl(220, 10%, 25%); border-radius: 3px; overflow: hidden; } .dl-progress-fill { height: 100%; background: #2d8ceb; border-radius: 3px; transition: width 0.15s ease-out; width: 0%; } /* ── Desktop: Device Manager modal ── */ .dm-section { background: var(--bg); border-radius: var(--radius-md); border: 1px solid var(--border); padding: 12px; } .dm-section-title { font-size: 10px; color: var(--text-muted); text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.08em; margin-bottom: 8px; } .dm-row { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; font-size: 12px; padding: 3px 0; } .dm-label { color: var(--text-muted); } .dm-value { font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; } .dm-bar { height: 6px; background: var(--border); border-radius: 3px; overflow: hidden; margin-top: 4px; } .dm-bar-fill { height: 100%; background: var(--accent); border-radius: 3px; transition: width 0.3s; } /* ── Serial Logs drawer (USB-only) ─────────────────────────── */ #logsToggleBtn { position: fixed; bottom: 16px; right: 16px; z-index: 1900; width: 40px; height: 40px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--panel-elevated); border: 1px solid var(--border); color: var(--text-muted); cursor: pointer; display: none; align-items: center; justify-content: center; box-shadow: var(--shadow-md); transition: color .15s, border-color .15s; } #logsToggleBtn.visible { display: flex; } #logsToggleBtn:hover { color: var(--text); border-color: var(--text-muted); } #logsToggleBtn svg { width: 18px; height: 18px; } #logsToggleBtn .logs-new-dot { position: absolute; top: 6px; right: 6px; width: 8px; height: 8px; border-radius: 50%; background: hsl(160, 70%, 50%); display: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px var(--panel-elevated); } #logsToggleBtn.has-new .logs-new-dot { display: block; } #logsDrawer { position: fixed; top: 0; right: 0; bottom: 0; width: min(420px, 95vw); background: var(--panel-elevated); border-left: 1px solid var(--border); box-shadow: -4px 0 20px rgba(0,0,0,0.4); z-index: 1950; display: flex; flex-direction: column; transform: translateX(100%); transition: transform .2s ease-out; font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; } #logsDrawer.open { transform: translateX(0); } .logs-header { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding: 12px 14px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border); flex-shrink: 0; } .logs-header h3 { margin: 0; flex: 1; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--text); } .logs-header button { background: none; border: 1px solid var(--border); color: var(--text-muted); cursor: pointer; font-size: 10px; padding: 4px 8px; border-radius: var(--radius-sm); font-family: inherit; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.04em; } .logs-header button:hover { color: var(--text); border-color: var(--text-muted); } .logs-header .logs-close { border: none; font-size: 18px; padding: 0 4px; line-height: 1; } .logs-list { flex: 1; overflow-y: auto; overflow-x: hidden; padding: 8px 0; font-size: 11px; line-height: 1.45; background: var(--bg); } .logs-list .log-line { padding: 1px 14px; white-space: pre-wrap; word-break: break-word; color: var(--text); } .logs-list .log-line.lvl-w { color: hsl(38, 90%, 60%); } .logs-list .log-line.lvl-e { color: hsl(0, 75%, 65%); } .logs-list .log-line.lvl-d { color: hsl(0, 0%, 50%); } .logs-list .log-line.lvl-v { color: hsl(0, 0%, 38%); } .logs-empty { padding: 16px 14px; color: var(--text-muted); font-size: 11px; font-style: italic; } .logs-paused-banner { display: none; position: absolute; bottom: 12px; left: 50%; transform: translateX(-50%); background: hsl(38, 60%, 45%); color: white; padding: 4px 10px; border-radius: 12px; font-size: 10px; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: var(--shadow-md);
